items.title: 52031_Kenny Clarke oral history interview
items.q: Pops had heard me play around with Louis Russell and all these bands, at the Apollo

ctx.x: Well, Big Sidney was with the band. So he said, "Kenny, Pops digs you." Now, Pops had heard me play around with Louis Russell and all these bands, at the Apollo, because he was sweet on this little girl he married. She was a chorus girl at the Apollo Theater, so Louis used to be around a lot.
